parameters.content:
daylog setup
- Set workflow timezone to Asia/Kolkata (workflow settings).
- Airtable: pick the daylog base + tables (categories, time_logs, standups, weekly_summary) on each Airtable node.
- Seed categories: study, reading, gym, walk, coding, college, work, event, chores, general (general = protected fallback).
- Standup/weekly chat ID placeholder must be filled for scheduled messages.
